codeReview.summary: This was a pure validation/verification feature — no code changes were expected or made. The worker correctly identified across 3 sessions that all 3 deferred M2 assertions (VAL-MISSION-013, VAL-CROSS-002, VAL-CROSS-009) were already passed in validation-state.json. Session 1 (788a12d4) was blocked by CDP unreachability. Session 2 (c59b6898) successfully connected to CDP 9230 and exercised VAL-CROSS-002 and VAL-CROSS-009 live, then found VAL-MISSION-013 blocked by Droid CLI handling tasks inline (no full Orchestrator decomposition). Session 3 (9d6f489d) verified all 3 were already marked passed and returned success. The validation-state.json confirms all 3 assertions show status 'passed'. VAL-CROSS-002 and VAL-CROSS-009 were validated with full CDP evidence (10 screenshots archived). VAL-MISSION-013 was passed via orchestrator override since UI cancel code paths are covered by 37 DOM tests in useMissionState.dom.test.tsx. No code changes were warranted.

issues.description: VAL-MISSION-013 was marked 'passed' via orchestrator override rather than direct CDP exercise. The override note explains that full Orchestrator decomposition wasn't triggered because the Droid CLI handled tasks inline — this is an external runtime dependency outside the app's control. The UI cancel mechanism was verified working (Processing badge + stop button visible) and 37 DOM tests cover the cancel/abort code paths. This is a reasonable override, but it means the live cancel-during-active-Orchestrator-decomposition flow was never exercised end-to-end.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature used droid-backend-worker skill but the task was a validation-only verification. The skill's procedure is oriented toward TDD code changes (red-green-commit cycle). A validation-only feature with no expected code changes doesn't fit the TDD workflow. This didn't cause issues because the worker recognized no code changes were needed, but a specialized validation-only skill or an explicit 'no-code-change verification' path in the skill would be cleaner.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Feature description says 'Desktop CDP validation of 3 deferred M2 mission-ux assertions' — purely verification work. Skill SKILL.md mandates 'Red first — write failing test' but no tests were needed here.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Session 1 (788a12d4) failed because CDP 9230 was unreachable — the Electron app was running as a production build without --remote-debugging-port. AGENTS.md documents that 'If CDP is unreachable, STOP and return to orchestrator' which the worker correctly followed. However, the repeated pattern of workers failing on first CDP attempt suggests services.yaml healthcheck alone isn't sufficient as a pre-flight gate — the orchestrator should check CDP availability before dispatching CDP-dependent features.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff 788a12d4: 'CDP 9230 unreachable — Electron runs as production build without remote-debugging-port'. Worker correctly returned to orchestrator per AGENTS.md rules.
